name: Norwalk
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Norwalk, CT 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Norwalk, CT for 2026: Shark Diving Santa, Rudolph 4D, indoor snow and a Noon Year's Eve countdown at the Maritime Aquarium.
lede: Norwalk's holiday season centers on the Maritime Aquarium, where Santa dives with sharks, snow falls indoors every hour and the new year arrives at noon.
celebrates: The Maritime Aquarium at 10 North Water Street is the heart of Norwalk's family Christmas season. Santa Claus dives with sand tiger and sandbar sharks in the Ocean Beyond the Sound exhibit on weekends from November 28 through December 27. A Flurry Zone makes an indoor snow squall every hour on the hour in December, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer plays in the 4D theater through January 3, and a Noon Year's Eve celebration on December 31 lets young children welcome the new year at 12 noon.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap of the aquarium's holiday season, so this page leans on the host page for 2026. A Connecticut Post story from an earlier season described Santa scuba diving on weekends in the aquarium's 110,000 gallon tank, which tells us the diving Santa is a recurring tradition. This year's page also lists a Polar Express screening in 3D on select dates and an Elf Power VR ride that guests can add at any cashier.
facts: The aquarium says the Santa dives happen in its Ocean Beyond the Sound exhibit with sand tiger and sandbar sharks. Its Rudolph film is a 10-minute adaptation made with the same stop-motion animation as the television classic. The Flurry Zone snow evaporates as it hits the floor, so nobody needs a shovel, and the aquarium runs the snow squalls for five minutes every hour from 10 am to 4 pm in Newman's Own Hall.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Norwalk itself. Our Connecticut guide at /blog/christmas-train-ride-connecticut lists the Christmas train rides across the state. The nearest ride on our site is the Santa Trains at the Danbury Railway Museum, about a 40 minute drive north, where weekend rides run from November 28. Norwalk has Metro-North New Haven Line stations, so families can also reach the aquarium district without a car.
traditions: Santa dives with sand tiger and sandbar sharks on weekends from November 28 to December 27.
An indoor snow squall falls every hour on the hour in December from 10 am to 4 pm.
A 10-minute stop-motion Rudolph film plays in the 4D theater through January 3.
Families with young children count down to 12 noon on December 31.
The aquarium shows the film on select dates and gives each guest a golden ticket and sleigh bell.
kidfact: At the Maritime Aquarium, Santa puts on scuba gear and swims with sharks, and the snow in the Flurry Zone melts the moment it touches the floor.
faq: What are the best Christmas events for kids in Norwalk?

The Maritime Aquarium has the most listings: Shark Diving Santa on weekends from November 28 to December 27, indoor snow every hour in December, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer 4D through January 3 and a Noon Year's Eve countdown on December 31.
Is Santa free to see at the Maritime Aquarium?

The aquarium says Shark Diving Santa is free with aquarium admission, so you need a regular aquarium ticket. The 4D Rudolph film costs $7.95 per person, or $6.95 for members, and aquarium admission is optional for that movie.
What time does Santa dive with the sharks?

Dives are on Saturdays and Sundays at 10:30 am for a photo op only and at 12:30 pm for a shark presentation plus a photo op. Extra photo ops are listed for November 27 at 11 am and December 24 at 10:30 am.
When does the indoor snow fall at the Maritime Aquarium?
The Flurry Zone makes a five-minute snow squall every hour on the hour from 10 am to 4 pm, every day in December, in Newman's Own Hall. The aquarium says the flakes evaporate as they hit the floor.
Is there a Noon Year's Eve party for kids in Norwalk?
Yes. The aquarium holds a Noon Year's Eve celebration on December 31 from 10 am to 1 pm with magical performances, face painting, a craft and a countdown to noon. It is free with aquarium admission.
